title: エリザベス女王杯の後に・ツンツン女王

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: How do you like that, Vodka? I'm the queen. Now you have to do whatever I say.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Grrr! I really wanted to win today! For more reasons than one…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Fine… Go on then, Queen. Gimme an order!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: When we get back to our dorm, you'll be doing alllll the chores. That includes the cleaning and cooking…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: And you'll be wearing a frilly maid apron, of course. ♪

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Are you serious?! That's goin' way too far!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: If you're really gonna make me do that, I'm movin' out! I'll get on my motorcycle and never come back!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, you really don't like that one, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: All right, I suppose I can choose something else. I've got just the thing.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I want you to keep being my rival.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You need to keep coming back to race me. Time and time again. Got it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wh-what? Why are you so quiet?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ya don't gotta get so serious out of nowhere…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You're the one who wanted me to choose something different!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I can't take this anymore! Take this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet sends a flurry of kicks at Vodka. It seems Vodka has incurred the queen's wrath.
